hint.tools: Tip 1 of 3: Pick a tool and click into the area. Lines snap to corners, midpoints and the grid; Shift keeps them straight.
hint.coords: Tip 2 of 3: For exact sizes type here: 50,20 is a point, @40,0 goes 40 mm to the right, 30<45 goes 30 mm at 45°.
hint.ai: Tip 3 of 3: Under “AI assistant” describe a part in words. The AI draws and models with you; you accept only what fits.
help.projects.title: Projects
help.projects.p1: A project holds a 2D drawing and a 3D model. You edit both in the editor.
help.projects.p2: Right-click or “…” on a project offers duplicate, print and delete. Tick the boxes to select several, with Shift for a range.
help.projects.p3: Deleted projects stay in the bin for 30 days under Settings → Data.
help.editor.title: How the editor works
help.editor.p1: At the top you switch between the drawing (2D) and the 3D model. All sizes are millimetres.
help.editor.p2: Drawing: pick a tool, click points or type them below (50,20 absolute, @40,0 relative, 30<45 length and angle). Change selected items exactly under Properties on the right.
help.editor.p3: 3D: add boxes, cylinders, spheres and cones or extrude a closed shape. A solid set to “Hole” is subtracted from the rest. Drag to orbit, Shift-drag to pan, the mouse wheel zooms.
help.editor.p4: “Drawing from 3D” calculates front, top and side views with hidden edges and dimensions. “Print” outputs it to scale with a title block, also as PDF.
help.editor.p5: Import: STL, OBJ, DXF and G-code. Export: STL and OBJ for the printer, DXF and SVG for other programs, G-code for the router. Ctrl+Z undoes, ? shows all shortcuts.

render.label: Display
render.qualityHint: Materials, shadows, reflections and surfaces as on the finished part

material.label: Material
material.hint: The “Realistic” display shows material and colour with surface, gloss and layer lines. They do not change STL or G-code.
thread.title: Thread
thread.clearanceHint: Makes bolts thinner and threaded holes wider by this amount so printed parts fit. 0.1–0.2 mm for FDM, 0 for machining.
thread.hint: The thread is modelled with its real profile (60°, ISO 68-1) as a helix, with a run-out at both ends. Bolts stand on the plate next to the model.
thread.hintSelected: An internal thread goes straight through the centre of the selected part; an external thread stands on top of it.
thread.error: Check the values: the pitch is between 0.2 mm and a quarter of the diameter, the length at least two pitches, the clearance between 0 and 1 mm.
sample.boltNotes: Example of a real thread: ISO profile M8 × 1.25 as a helix, head 13 mm across flats. Switch the 3D model to “Realistic” to see steel, reflections and shadows.
opError.too_complex: too fine for a thread of this length
thread.tooComplex: At this length the thread gets too fine to show smoothly (over 400,000 triangles). Split it into shorter pieces or choose a larger pitch.
material.layerError: Enter a layer height between 0.04 and 1 mm.
